functions.name: fetch_rooms_cursor_full_v1
functions.identity: p_role integer, p_limit integer, p_cursor uuid, p_search text, p_min_price integer, p_max_price integer, p_districts text[], p_room_types text[], p_move text, p_pet_policies text[], p_contract_terms text[], p_statuses text[], p_sort text, p_cursor_updated_at timestamp with time zone, p_cursor_created_at timestamp with time zone, p_cursor_id uuid, p_anon_session_id uuid, p_vip_token_hash text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fetch_rooms_cursor_full_v1(p_role integer, p_limit integer, p_cursor uuid, p_search text, p_min_price integer, p_max_price integer, p_districts text[], p_room_types text[], p_move text, p_pet_policies text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_contract_terms text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_statuses text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_sort text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_cursor_updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_cursor_created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_cursor_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_anon_session_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_vip_token_hash text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
 s text := null;
 cursor_price integer := null;
 cursor_search_score integer := null;

 effective_role integer := 0;
 v_uid uuid := auth.uid();

 v_next uuid := null;
 v_next_cursor jsonb := null;
 v_data jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
 v_total integer := 0;
 v_is_vip boolean := false;

 sort_mode text := coalesce(nullif(p_sort, ''), 'updated_desc');

 anon_limit integer := 20;
 anon_search text := null;
 anon_min_price integer := null;
 anon_max_price integer := null;
 anon_districts text[] := null;
 anon_room_types text[] := null;
 anon_move text := null;
 anon_pet_policies text[] := null;
 anon_contract_terms text[] := null;
 anon_statuses text[] := null;
 anon_sort text := 'updated_desc';
begin
 if v_uid is not null then
  select coalesce(level, 0)
    into effective_role
  from public.admin_users
  where user_id = v_uid
  limit 1;

  if effective_role not in (1, 2) then
    effective_role := 0;
  end if;
else
  effective_role := 0;
 end if;


SELECT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1
  FROM public.vip_access_links
  WHERE token_hash = p_vip_token_hash
    AND revoked_at IS NULL
    AND expires_at > now()
)
INTO v_is_vip;


if effective_role = 0 
and v_is_vip = false then

  if p_anon_session_id is null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'data',
      '[]'::jsonb,
      'nextCursor',
      null,
      'total_count',
      0
    );
  end if;


  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.anon_sessions s0
    where s0.id = p_anon_session_id
      and (
        s0.created_at > now() - interval '60 seconds'
        or coalesce(
          s0.unlocked_until,
          '-infinity'::timestamptz
        ) > now()
      )
  ) then

    return jsonb_build_object(
      'data',
      '[]'::jsonb,
      'nextCursor',
      null,
      'total_count',
      0
    );

  end if;

end if;

 if p_search is not null then
  s := public.norm_room_search_text(btrim(p_search));
  if length(s) < 3 then
    s := null;
  end if;
 end if;

 if effective_role = 0 then
  if sort_mode not in ('updated_desc', 'price_asc', 'price_desc') then
    sort_mode := 'updated_desc';
  end if;

  if p_cursor is not null and sort_mode in ('price_asc', 'price_desc') then
    select v.price
    into cursor_price
    from public.room_full_public v
    where v.id = p_cursor;
  end if;

  if s is not null and p_cursor is not null then

    select
      public.room_address_search_score(v.house_number, v.address, v.ward, v.district, null, s)
    into cursor_search_score
    from public.room_full_public v
    where v.id = p_cursor;
  end if;

  with base as (
    select
      v.id,
      v.updated_at as updated_at,
      v.created_at as created_at,
      v.price as price,
      v.address as address,
      v.ward as ward,
      v.district as district,
      v.room_code as room_code,
      case
        when s is null then 0
        else public.room_address_search_score(v.house_number, v.address, v.ward, v.district, null, s)
      end::int as search_score,
      (
        (to_jsonb(v)
          - 'gallery_urls'
          - 'link_zalo'
          - 'zalo_phone'
          - 'chinh_sach'
        )
        || jsonb_build_object(
          'badges', coalesce(r.badges, '{}'::text[]), 'has_video',
            exists (
              select 1
              from public.room_media rm
              where rm.room_id = v.id
                and rm.type = 'video'
                and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
            ),
          'image_urls',
            (
              select coalesce(jsonb_agg(u), '[]'::jsonb)
              from (
                select rm.url as u
                from public.room_media rm
                where rm.room_id = v.id
                  and rm.type = 'image'
                  and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
                order by rm.created_at asc
                limit 3
              ) t
            ),
          'image_count',
            (
              select count(*)::int
              from public.room_media rm
              where rm.room_id = v.id
                and rm.type = 'image'
                and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
            ),
          'video_url',
            (
              select rm.url
              from public.room_media rm
              where rm.room_id = v.id
                and rm.type = 'video'
                and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
              order by rm.created_at asc
              limit 1
            ),
          'thumb_url',
            (
              select rm.url
              from public.room_media rm
              where rm.room_id = v.id
                and rm.type = 'image'
                and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
              order by rm.created_at asc
              limit 1
            ),
          'room_detail', to_jsonb(rd),
          'updated_at', v.updated_at,
          'creator_admin_phone', au.phone,
          'creator_admin_name', au.full_name,
        'available_from', r.available_from
        )
      ) as row_json
    from public.room_full_public v
    left join public.rooms r on r.id = v.id
    left join public.admin_users au on au.user_id = r.owner_id
    left join public.room_details rd on rd.room_id = v.id
    where
      (p_min_price is null or v.price >= p_min_price)
      and (p_max_price is null or v.price <= p_max_price)
      and (
        p_districts is null
        or cardinality(p_districts) = 0
        or v.district = any(p_districts)
      )
      and (p_room_types is null or cardinality(p_room_types) = 0 or v.room_type = any(p_room_types))
      and (
        p_statuses is null
        or cardinality(p_statuses) = 0
        
or (
  (
    not exists (
      select 1 from unnest(p_statuses) as badge_filter(value)
      where left(badge_filter.value, 8) = '__badge:'
    )
    or exists (
      select 1 from unnest(p_statuses) as badge_filter(value)
      where left(badge_filter.value, 8) = '__badge:'
        and r.badges @> array[substring(badge_filter.value from 9)]::text[]
    )
  )
  and (
    not exists (
      select 1 from unnest(p_statuses) as status_filter(value)
      where left(status_filter.value, 8) <> '__badge:'
    )
    or v.status = any(array(
      select status_filter.value from unnest(p_statuses) as status_filter(value)
      where left(status_filter.value, 8) <> '__badge:'
    ))
  )
)
      )
      and (
        p_move is null
        or (p_move = 'elevator' and coalesce(rd.has_elevator, false) = true)
        or (p_move = 'stairs' and coalesce(rd.has_stairs, false) = true)
      )
      and (
        p_pet_policies is null
        or cardinality(p_pet_policies) = 0
        or (
          ('cat' = any(p_pet_policies) and coalesce(v.allow_cat, false) = true)
          or ('dog' = any(p_pet_policies) and coalesce(v.allow_dog, false) = true)
          or ('nopet' = any(p_pet_policies) and coalesce(v.no_pet, false) = true)
        )
      )
      and (
        p_contract_terms is null
        or cardinality(p_contract_terms) = 0
        or (
          ('short' = any(p_contract_terms) and coalesce(v.short_term, false) = true)
          or ('long' = any(p_contract_terms) and coalesce(v.long_term, true) = true)
        )
      )
      and (
        s is null
        or r.search_address_text like s || '%'
        or r.search_address_text like '%' || s || '%'
        or r.search_address_text operator(extensions.%) s
      )
  ),
  total_cte as (
    select count(*)::int as total_count from base
  ),
  src as (
    select
      b.id,
      b.updated_at,
      b.created_at,
      b.price,
      b.search_score,
      b.row_json
    from base b
    where
      (
        (
          s is not null
          and (
            p_cursor is null
            or cursor_search_score is null
            or b.search_score < cursor_search_score
            or (
              b.search_score = cursor_search_score
              and (
                (
                  p_cursor_updated_at is not null
                  and (
                    b.updated_at < p_cursor_updated_at
                    or (
                      b.updated_at = p_cursor_updated_at
                      and (
                        (p_cursor_created_at is not null and b.created_at < p_cursor_created_at)
                        or (
                          p_cursor_created_at is not null
                          and b.created_at = p_cursor_created_at
                          and p_cursor_id is not null
                          and b.id < p_cursor_id
                        )
                        or (
                          p_cursor_created_at is null
                          and p_cursor_id is not null
                          and b.id < p_cursor_id
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
                or (
                  p_cursor_updated_at is null
                  and p_cursor is not null
                  and b.id < p_cursor
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        or
        (
          s is null
          and (
            (
              sort_mode = 'updated_desc'
              and (
                p_cursor_updated_at is null
                or (b.updated_at < p_cursor_updated_at)
                or (
                  b.updated_at = p_cursor_updated_at
                  and (
                    (p_cursor_created_at is not null and b.created_at < p_cursor_created_at)
                    or (
                      p_cursor_created_at is not null
                      and b.created_at = p_cursor_created_at
                      and p_cursor_id is not null
                      and b.id < p_cursor_id
                    )
                    or (
                      p_cursor_created_at is null
                      and p_cursor_id is not null
                      and b.id < p_cursor_id
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
            or (
              sort_mode = 'price_asc'
              and cursor_price is not null
              and (b.price > cursor_price or (b.price = cursor_price and b.id > p_cursor))
            )
            or (
              sort_mode = 'price_desc'
              and cursor_price is not null
              and (b.price < cursor_price or (b.price = cursor_price and b.id > p_cursor))
            )
            or (
              (
                sort_mode not in ('updated_desc', 'price_asc', 'price_desc')
                or (
                  sort_mode in ('price_asc', 'price_desc')
                  and cursor_price is null
                )
              )
              and (p_cursor is null or b.id > p_cursor)
            )
            or (p_cursor is null and p_cursor_updated_at is null)
          )
        )
      )
    order by
      case when s is not null then b.search_score end desc,
      case when s is not null then b.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then b.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then b.id end desc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then b.price end asc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then b.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then b.price end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then b.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then b.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then b.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then b.id end desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 50) + 1
  ),
  sliced as (
    select * from src order by
      case when s is not null then src.search_score end desc,
      case when s is not null then src.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then src.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then src.id end desc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then src.price end asc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then src.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then src.price end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then src.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.id end desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 50)
  ),
  has_more as (
    select exists(select 1 from src offset least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 50) limit 1) as ok
  ),
  last_row as (
    select id, updated_at, created_at, search_score
    from src
    order by
      case when s is not null then src.search_score end desc,
      case when s is not null then src.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then src.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then src.id end desc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then src.price end asc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then src.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then src.price end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then src.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.id end desc
    offset greatest(least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 50) - 1, 0)
    limit 1
  )
  select
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(sliced.row_json order by
      case when s is not null then sliced.search_score end desc,
      case when s is not null then sliced.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then sliced.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then sliced.id end desc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then sliced.price end asc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then sliced.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then sliced.price end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then sliced.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then sliced.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then sliced.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then sliced.id end desc
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    (select case when (select ok from has_more) then (select id from last_row) else null end),
    (select case when (select ok from has_more)
      then jsonb_build_object(
        'updated_at', (select updated_at from last_row),
        'created_at', (select created_at from last_row),
        'id', (select id from last_row),
        'search_score', (select search_score from last_row)
      )
      else null
    end),
    (select total_count from total_cte)
  into v_data, v_next, v_next_cursor, v_total
  from sliced;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'data', v_data,
    'nextCursor',
    case
      when s is not null or sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then v_next_cursor
      else to_jsonb(v_next)
    end,
    'total_count', v_total
  );
 end if;

 if effective_role = 1 then
  if p_cursor is not null and sort_mode in ('price_asc', 'price_desc') then
    select v.price
    into cursor_price
    from public.room_full_admin_l1 v
    join public.rooms r on r.id = v.id
    where v.id = p_cursor;
  end if;

  if s is not null and p_cursor is not null then
    select
      public.room_address_search_score(v.house_number, v.address, v.ward, v.district, null, s)
    into cursor_search_score
    from public.room_full_admin_l1 v
    where v.id = p_cursor;
  end if;

  with base as (
    select
      v.id,
      v.updated_at as updated_at,
      r.created_at as created_at,
      v.price as price,
      v.house_number as house_number,
      v.address as address,
      v.ward as ward,
      v.district as district,
      v.room_code as room_code,
      case
        when s is null then 0
        else public.room_address_search_score(v.house_number, v.address, v.ward, v.district, null, s)
      end::int as search_score,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', v.id,
        'room_code', v.room_code,
        'room_type', v.room_type,
        'house_number', v.house_number,
        'address', v.address,
        'ward', v.ward,
        'district', v.district,
        'price', v.price,
        'room_detail', to_jsonb(rd),
          'updated_at', v.updated_at,
        'status', v.status,
        'badges', coalesce(r.badges, '{}'::text[]), 'has_video',
          exists (
            select 1
            from public.room_media rm
            where rm.room_id = v.id
              and rm.type = 'video'
              and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
          ),
        'video_url',
          (
            select rm.url
            from public.room_media rm
            where rm.room_id = v.id
              and rm.type = 'video'
              and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
            order by rm.created_at asc
            limit 1
          ),
        'thumb_url',
          (
            select rm.url
            from public.room_media rm
            where rm.room_id = v.id
              and rm.type = 'image'
              and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
            order by rm.created_at asc
            limit 1
          ),
        'image_urls',
          (
            select coalesce(jsonb_agg(u), '[]'::jsonb)
            from (
              select rm.url as u
              from public.room_media rm
              where rm.room_id = v.id
                and rm.type = 'image'
                and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
              order by rm.created_at asc
              limit 3
            ) t
          ),
        'image_count',
          (
            select count(*)::int
            from public.room_media rm
            where rm.room_id = v.id
              and rm.type = 'image'
              and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
          ),
        'description', v.description,
        'room_detail', to_jsonb(rd),
          'updated_at', v.updated_at,
        'owner_id', r.owner_id,
        'link_zalo',
          case
            when r.owner_id = v_uid then v.link_zalo
            else null
          end,
        'zalo_phone',
          case
            when r.owner_id = v_uid then v.zalo_phone
            else null
          end,
        'creator_admin_phone', au.phone,
        'creator_admin_name', au.full_name,
        'available_from', r.available_from
      ) as row_json
    from public.room_full_admin_l1 v
    join public.rooms r on r.id = v.id
    left join public.admin_users au on au.user_id = r.owner_id
    left join public.room_details rd on rd.room_id = v.id
    where
      (p_min_price is null or v.price >= p_min_price)
      and (p_max_price is null or v.price <= p_max_price)
      and (
        p_districts is null
        or cardinality(p_districts) = 0
        or v.district = any(p_districts)
      )
      and (p_room_types is null or cardinality(p_room_types) = 0 or v.room_type = any(p_room_types))
      and (
        p_statuses is null
        or cardinality(p_statuses) = 0
        
or (
  (
    not exists (
      select 1 from unnest(p_statuses) as badge_filter(value)
      where left(badge_filter.value, 8) = '__badge:'
    )
    or exists (
      select 1 from unnest(p_statuses) as badge_filter(value)
      where left(badge_filter.value, 8) = '__badge:'
        and r.badges @> array[substring(badge_filter.value from 9)]::text[]
    )
  )
  and (
    not exists (
      select 1 from unnest(p_statuses) as status_filter(value)
      where left(status_filter.value, 8) <> '__badge:'
    )
    or v.status = any(array(
      select status_filter.value from unnest(p_statuses) as status_filter(value)
      where left(status_filter.value, 8) <> '__badge:'
    ))
  )
)
      )
      and (
        p_move is null
        or (p_move = 'elevator' and coalesce(rd.has_elevator, false) = true)
        or (p_move = 'stairs' and coalesce(rd.has_stairs, false) = true)
      )
      and (
        p_pet_policies is null
        or cardinality(p_pet_policies) = 0
        or (
          ('cat' = any(p_pet_policies) and coalesce(v.allow_cat, false) = true)
          or ('dog' = any(p_pet_policies) and coalesce(v.allow_dog, false) = true)
          or ('nopet' = any(p_pet_policies) and coalesce(v.no_pet, false) = true)
        )
      )
      and (
        p_contract_terms is null
        or cardinality(p_contract_terms) = 0
        or (
          ('short' = any(p_contract_terms) and coalesce(v.short_term, false) = true)
          or ('long' = any(p_contract_terms) and coalesce(v.long_term, true) = true)
        )
      )
      and (
        s is null
        or r.search_address_text like s || '%'
        or r.search_address_text like '%' || s || '%'
        or r.search_address_text operator(extensions.%) s
      )
  ),
  total_cte as (
    select count(*)::int as total_count from base
  ),
  src as (
    select
      b.id,
      b.updated_at,
      b.created_at,
      b.price,
      b.search_score,
      b.row_json
    from base b
    where
      (
        (
          s is not null
          and (
            p_cursor is null
            or cursor_search_score is null
            or b.search_score < cursor_search_score
            or (
              b.search_score = cursor_search_score
              and (
                (
                  p_cursor_updated_at is not null
                  and (
                    b.updated_at < p_cursor_updated_at
                    or (
                      b.updated_at = p_cursor_updated_at
                      and (
                        (p_cursor_created_at is not null and b.created_at < p_cursor_created_at)
                        or (
                          p_cursor_created_at is not null
                          and b.created_at = p_cursor_created_at
                          and p_cursor_id is not null
                          and b.id < p_cursor_id
                        )
                        or (
                          p_cursor_created_at is null
                          and p_cursor_id is not null
                          and b.id < p_cursor_id
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
                or (
                  p_cursor_updated_at is null
                  and p_cursor is not null
                  and b.id < p_cursor
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        or
        (
          s is null
          and (
            (
              sort_mode = 'updated_desc'
              and (
                p_cursor_updated_at is null
                or (b.updated_at < p_cursor_updated_at)
                or (
                  b.updated_at = p_cursor_updated_at
                  and (
                    (p_cursor_created_at is not null and b.created_at < p_cursor_created_at)
                    or (
                      p_cursor_created_at is not null
                      and b.created_at = p_cursor_created_at
                      and p_cursor_id is not null
                      and b.id < p_cursor_id
                    )
                    or (
                      p_cursor_created_at is null
                      and p_cursor_id is null
                      and b.id < p_cursor_id
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
            or (
              sort_mode = 'price_asc'
              and cursor_price is not null
              and (b.price > cursor_price or (b.price = cursor_price and b.id > p_cursor))
            )
            or (
              sort_mode = 'price_desc'
              and cursor_price is not null
              and (b.price < cursor_price or (b.price = cursor_price and b.id > p_cursor))
            )
            or (
              (
                sort_mode not in ('updated_desc', 'price_asc', 'price_desc')
                or (
                  sort_mode in ('price_asc', 'price_desc')
                  and cursor_price is null
                )
              )
              and (p_cursor is null or b.id > p_cursor)
            )
            or (p_cursor is null and p_cursor_updated_at is null)
          )
        )
      )
    order by
      case when s is not null then b.search_score end desc,
      case when s is not null then b.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then b.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then b.id end desc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then b.price end asc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then b.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then b.price end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then b.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then b.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then b.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then b.id end desc
    limit p_limit + 1
  ),
  sliced as (
    select * from src order by
      case when s is not null then src.search_score end desc,
      case when s is not null then src.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then src.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then src.id end desc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then src.price end asc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then src.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then src.price end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then src.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.id end desc
    limit p_limit
  ),
  has_more as (
    select exists(select 1 from src offset p_limit limit 1) as ok
  ),
  last_row as (
    select id, updated_at, created_at, search_score
    from src
    order by
      case when s is not null then src.search_score end desc,
      case when s is not null then src.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then src.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then src.id end desc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then src.price end asc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then src.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then src.price end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then src.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.id end desc
    offset greatest(p_limit - 1, 0)
    limit 1
  )
  select
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(sliced.row_json order by
      case when s is not null then sliced.search_score end desc,
      case when s is not null then sliced.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then sliced.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then sliced.id end desc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then sliced.price end asc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then sliced.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then sliced.price end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then sliced.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then sliced.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then sliced.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then sliced.id end desc
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    (select case when (select ok from has_more) then (select id from last_row) else null end),
    (select case when (select ok from has_more)
      then jsonb_build_object(
        'updated_at', (select updated_at from last_row),
        'created_at', (select created_at from last_row),
        'id', (select id from last_row),
        'search_score', (select search_score from last_row)
      )
      else null
    end),
    (select total_count from total_cte)
  into v_data, v_next, v_next_cursor, v_total
  from sliced;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'data', v_data,
    'nextCursor',
    case
      when s is not null or sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then v_next_cursor
      else to_jsonb(v_next)
    end,
    'total_count', v_total
  );
 end if;

 if effective_role = 2 then
  if p_cursor is not null and sort_mode in ('price_asc', 'price_desc') then
    select v.price
    into cursor_price
    from public.room_full_admin_l2 v
    join public.rooms r on r.id = v.id
    where v.id = p_cursor;
  end if;

  if s is not null and p_cursor is not null then
    select
      public.room_address_search_score(v.house_number, v.address, v.ward, v.district, null, s)
    into cursor_search_score
    from public.room_full_admin_l2 v
    where v.id = p_cursor;
  end if;

  with base as (
    select
      v.id,
      v.updated_at as updated_at,
      r.created_at as created_at,
      v.price as price,
      v.house_number as house_number,
      v.address as address,
      v.ward as ward,
      v.district as district,
      v.room_code as room_code,
      case
        when s is null then 0
        else public.room_address_search_score(v.house_number, v.address, v.ward, v.district, null, s)
      end::int as search_score,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', v.id,
        'room_code', v.room_code,
        'room_type', v.room_type,
        'house_number', v.house_number,
        'address', v.address,
        'ward', v.ward,
        'district', v.district,
        'price', v.price,
        'room_detail', to_jsonb(rd),
          'updated_at', v.updated_at,
        'status', v.status,
        'badges', coalesce(r.badges, '{}'::text[]), 'has_video',
          exists (
            select 1
            from public.room_media rm
            where rm.room_id = v.id
              and rm.type = 'video'
              and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
          ),
        'video_url',
          (
            select rm.url
            from public.room_media rm
            where rm.room_id = v.id
              and rm.type = 'video'
              and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
            order by rm.created_at asc
            limit 1
          ),
        'thumb_url',
          (
            select rm.url
            from public.room_media rm
            where rm.room_id = v.id
              and rm.type = 'image'
              and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
            order by rm.created_at asc
            limit 1
          ),
        'image_urls',
          (
            select coalesce(jsonb_agg(u), '[]'::jsonb)
            from (
              select rm.url as u
              from public.room_media rm
              where rm.room_id = v.id
                and rm.type = 'image'
                and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
              order by rm.created_at asc
              limit 3
            ) t
          ),
        'image_count',
          (
            select count(*)::int
            from public.room_media rm
            where rm.room_id = v.id
              and rm.type = 'image'
              and coalesce(rm.url, '') <> ''
          ),
        'description', v.description,
        'room_detail', to_jsonb(rd),
          'updated_at', v.updated_at,
        'owner_id', r.owner_id,
        'link_zalo',
          case
            when r.owner_id = v_uid then v.link_zalo
            else null
          end,
        'zalo_phone',
          case
            when r.owner_id = v_uid then v.zalo_phone
            else null
          end,
        'creator_admin_phone', au.phone,
        'creator_admin_name', au.full_name,
        'available_from', r.available_from
      ) as row_json
    from public.room_full_admin_l2 v
    join public.rooms r on r.id = v.id
    left join public.admin_users au on au.user_id = r.owner_id
    left join public.room_details rd on rd.room_id = v.id
    where
      coalesce(r.is_hidden, false) = false
      and (p_min_price is null or v.price >= p_min_price)
      and (p_max_price is null or v.price <= p_max_price)
      and (
        p_districts is null
        or cardinality(p_districts) = 0
        or v.district = any(p_districts)
      )
      and (p_room_types is null or cardinality(p_room_types) = 0 or v.room_type = any(p_room_types))
      and (
        p_statuses is null
        or cardinality(p_statuses) = 0
        
or (
  (
    not exists (
      select 1 from unnest(p_statuses) as badge_filter(value)
      where left(badge_filter.value, 8) = '__badge:'
    )
    or exists (
      select 1 from unnest(p_statuses) as badge_filter(value)
      where left(badge_filter.value, 8) = '__badge:'
        and r.badges @> array[substring(badge_filter.value from 9)]::text[]
    )
  )
  and (
    not exists (
      select 1 from unnest(p_statuses) as status_filter(value)
      where left(status_filter.value, 8) <> '__badge:'
    )
    or v.status = any(array(
      select status_filter.value from unnest(p_statuses) as status_filter(value)
      where left(status_filter.value, 8) <> '__badge:'
    ))
  )
)
      )
      and (
        p_move is null
        or (p_move = 'elevator' and coalesce(rd.has_elevator, false) = true)
        or (p_move = 'stairs' and coalesce(rd.has_stairs, false) = true)
      )
      and (
        p_pet_policies is null
        or cardinality(p_pet_policies) = 0
        or (
          ('cat' = any(p_pet_policies) and coalesce(v.allow_cat, false) = true)
          or ('dog' = any(p_pet_policies) and coalesce(v.allow_dog, false) = true)
          or ('nopet' = any(p_pet_policies) and coalesce(v.no_pet, false) = true)
        )
      )
      and (
        p_contract_terms is null
        or cardinality(p_contract_terms) = 0
        or (
          ('short' = any(p_contract_terms) and coalesce(v.short_term, false) = true)
          or ('long' = any(p_contract_terms) and coalesce(v.long_term, true) = true)
        )
      )
      and (
        s is null
        or r.search_address_text like s || '%'
        or r.search_address_text like '%' || s || '%'
        or r.search_address_text operator(extensions.%) s
      )
  ),
  total_cte as (
    select count(*)::int as total_count from base
  ),
  src as (
    select
      b.id,
      b.updated_at,
      b.created_at,
      b.price,
      b.search_score,
      b.row_json
    from base b
    where
      (
        (
          s is not null
          and (
            p_cursor is null
            or cursor_search_score is null
            or b.search_score < cursor_search_score
            or (
              b.search_score = cursor_search_score
              and (
                (
                  p_cursor_updated_at is not null
                  and (
                    b.updated_at < p_cursor_updated_at
                    or (
                      b.updated_at = p_cursor_updated_at
                      and (
                        (p_cursor_created_at is not null and b.created_at < p_cursor_created_at)
                        or (
                          p_cursor_created_at is not null
                          and b.created_at = p_cursor_created_at
                          and p_cursor_id is not null
                          and b.id < p_cursor_id
                        )
                        or (
                          p_cursor_created_at is null
                          and p_cursor_id is not null
                          and b.id < p_cursor_id
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
                or (
                  p_cursor_updated_at is null
                  and p_cursor is not null
                  and b.id < p_cursor
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        or
        (
          s is null
          and (
            (
              sort_mode = 'updated_desc'
              and (
                p_cursor_updated_at is null
                or (b.updated_at < p_cursor_updated_at)
                or (
                  b.updated_at = p_cursor_updated_at
                  and (
                    (p_cursor_created_at is not null and b.created_at < p_cursor_created_at)
                    or (
                      p_cursor_created_at is not null
                      and b.created_at = p_cursor_created_at
                      and p_cursor_id is not null
                      and b.id < p_cursor_id
                    )
                    or (
                      p_cursor_created_at is null
                      and p_cursor_id is not null
                      and b.id < p_cursor_id
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
            or (
              sort_mode = 'price_asc'
              and cursor_price is not null
              and (b.price > cursor_price or (b.price = cursor_price and b.id > p_cursor))
            )
            or (
              sort_mode = 'price_desc'
              and cursor_price is not null
              and (b.price < cursor_price or (b.price = cursor_price and b.id > p_cursor))
            )
            or (
              (
                sort_mode not in ('updated_desc', 'price_asc', 'price_desc')
                or (
                  sort_mode in ('price_asc', 'price_desc')
                  and cursor_price is null
                )
              )
              and (p_cursor is null or b.id > p_cursor)
            )
            or (p_cursor is null and p_cursor_updated_at is null)
          )
        )
      )
    order by
      case when s is not null then b.search_score end desc,
      case when s is not null then b.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then b.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then b.id end desc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then b.price end asc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then b.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then b.price end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then b.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then b.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then b.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then b.id end desc
    limit p_limit + 1
  ),
  sliced as (
    select * from src order by
      case when s is not null then src.search_score end desc,
      case when s is not null then src.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then src.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then src.id end desc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then src.price end asc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then src.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then src.price end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then src.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.id end desc
    limit p_limit
  ),
  has_more as (
    select exists(select 1 from src offset p_limit limit 1) as ok
  ),
  last_row as (
    select id, updated_at, created_at, search_score
    from src
    order by
      case when s is not null then src.search_score end desc,
      case when s is not null then src.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then src.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then src.id end desc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then src.price end asc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then src.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then src.price end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then src.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then src.id end desc
    offset greatest(p_limit - 1, 0)
    limit 1
  )
  select
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(sliced.row_json order by
      case when s is not null then sliced.search_score end desc,
      case when s is not null then sliced.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then sliced.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is not null then sliced.id end desc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then sliced.price end asc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_asc' then sliced.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then sliced.price end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'price_desc' then sliced.id end asc,

      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then sliced.updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then sliced.created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when s is null and sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then sliced.id end desc
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    (select case when (select ok from has_more) then (select id from last_row) else null end),
    (select case when (select ok from has_more)
      then jsonb_build_object(
        'updated_at', (select updated_at from last_row),
        'created_at', (select created_at from last_row),
        'id', (select id from last_row),
        'search_score', (select search_score from last_row)
      )
      else null
    end),
    (select total_count from total_cte)
  into v_data, v_next, v_next_cursor, v_total
  from sliced;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'data', v_data,
    'nextCursor',
    case
      when s is not null or sort_mode = 'updated_desc' then v_next_cursor
      else to_jsonb(v_next)
    end,
    'total_count', v_total
  );
 end if;

 return jsonb_build_object('data', '[]'::jsonb, 'nextCursor', null, 'total_count', 0);
end;
$function$

functions.name: room_address_search_score
functions.identity: p_house_number text, p_address text, p_ward text, p_district text, p_room_code text, p_search text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.room_address_search_score(p_house_number text, p_address text, p_ward text, p_district text, p_room_code text, p_search text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with normalized as (
    select
      public.norm_room_search_text(coalesce(p_house_number, '')) as house_number,
      public.norm_room_search_text(coalesce(p_address, '')) as address,
      public.norm_room_search_text(
        concat_ws(' ', p_house_number, p_address)
      ) as street_address,
      public.norm_room_search_text(
        concat_ws(' ', p_house_number, p_address, p_ward, p_district)
      ) as full_address,
      public.norm_room_search_text(coalesce(p_search, '')) as query
  )
  select case
    when query = '' then 0

    -- 100% matches always win. House number is first because users commonly
    -- search only for values such as "257/17".
    when house_number = query then 12000
    when full_address = query then 11900
    when street_address = query then 11800
    when address = query then 11700

    -- A phrase at the beginning is stronger than the same phrase elsewhere.
    when street_address like query || '%' then 10500
    when full_address like query || '%' then 10400
    when street_address like '%' || query || '%' then 9500
    when full_address like '%' || query || '%' then 9400
    when house_number like '%' || query || '%' then 9300

    -- Fuzzy candidates can never outrank a strict match.
    else 1000 + round(extensions.similarity(full_address, query) * 5000)::integer
  end
  from normalized;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_room_details_v1(p_room_id uuid, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.save_room_details_v1_without_free_time(p_room_id, p_payload);
  if p_payload ? 'free_time' then
    update public.room_details
    set free_time = coalesce((p_payload->>'free_time')::boolean, false)
    where room_id = p_room_id;
  end if;
end;
$function$

norm_room_search_text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.norm_room_search_text(t text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select trim(
    regexp_replace(
      regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(
          regexp_replace(
            lower(coalesce(t, '')),
            '[,.;:]+',
            ' ',
            'g'
          ),
          '\m(phường|phuong|p)\M',
          ' ',
          'g'
        ),
        '\m(quận|quan|q)\M',
        ' ',
        'g'
      ),
      '\s+',
      ' ',
      'g'
    )
  );
$function$

functions.name: save_room_details_v1_without_free_time
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_room_details_v1_without_free_time(p_room_id uuid, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_no_pet boolean;
  v_allow_pet boolean;
  v_allow_cat boolean;
  v_allow_dog boolean;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'UNAUTHENTICATED';
  end if;

  if p_room_id is null then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '22023',
      message = 'INVALID_INPUT',
      detail = 'room_id is required';
  end if;

  if p_payload is null or jsonb_typeof(p_payload) <> 'object' then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '22023',
      message = 'INVALID_INPUT',
      detail = 'payload must be a JSON object';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.rooms r
    where r.id = p_room_id
  ) then
    raise exception using
      errcode = 'P0002',
      message = 'NOT_FOUND',
      detail = 'Room not found';
  end if;

  if not public.can_manage_room(p_room_id)
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.admin_users au
      where au.user_id = auth.uid()
        and au.level in (1, 2)
    )
  then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '42501',
      message = 'FORBIDDEN';
  end if;

  select
    case
      when p_payload ? 'no_pet'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'no_pet')::boolean, false)
      else coalesce(rd.no_pet, false)
    end,
    case
      when p_payload ? 'allow_pet'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'allow_pet')::boolean, false)
      else coalesce(rd.allow_pet, false)
    end,
    case
      when p_payload ? 'allow_cat'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'allow_cat')::boolean, false)
      else coalesce(rd.allow_cat, false)
    end,
    case
      when p_payload ? 'allow_dog'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'allow_dog')::boolean, false)
      else coalesce(rd.allow_dog, false)
    end
  into
    v_no_pet,
    v_allow_pet,
    v_allow_cat,
    v_allow_dog
  from (
    select 1
  ) seed
  left join public.room_details rd
    on rd.room_id = p_room_id;

  if v_no_pet then
    v_allow_pet := false;
    v_allow_cat := false;
    v_allow_dog := false;
  end if;

  insert into public.room_details (
    id,
    room_id,
    electric_fee_value,
    electric_fee_unit,
    water_fee_value,
    water_fee_unit,
    service_fee_value,
    service_fee_unit,
    parking_fee_value,
    parking_fee_unit,
    other_fee_value,
    other_fee_note,
    has_elevator,
    has_stairs,
    shared_washer,
    private_washer,
    shared_dryer,
    private_dryer,
    has_parking,
    has_basement,
    fingerprint_lock,
    allow_pet,
    allow_cat,
    allow_dog,
    no_pet,
    short_term,
    long_term,
    other_amenities,
    detail_json,
    created_at
  )
  values (
    gen_random_uuid(),
    p_room_id,
    nullif(p_payload->>'electric_fee_value', '')::numeric,
    nullif(p_payload->>'electric_fee_unit', ''),
    nullif(p_payload->>'water_fee_value', '')::numeric,
    nullif(p_payload->>'water_fee_unit', ''),
    nullif(p_payload->>'service_fee_value', '')::numeric,
    nullif(p_payload->>'service_fee_unit', ''),
    nullif(p_payload->>'parking_fee_value', '')::numeric,
    nullif(p_payload->>'parking_fee_unit', ''),
    nullif(p_payload->>'other_fee_value', '')::numeric,
    nullif(p_payload->>'other_fee_note', ''),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'has_elevator')::boolean, false),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'has_stairs')::boolean, false),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'shared_washer')::boolean, false),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'private_washer')::boolean, false),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'shared_dryer')::boolean, false),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'private_dryer')::boolean, false),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'has_parking')::boolean, false),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'has_basement')::boolean, false),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'fingerprint_lock')::boolean, false),
    v_allow_pet,
    v_allow_cat,
    v_allow_dog,
    v_no_pet,
    coalesce((p_payload->>'short_term')::boolean, false),
    coalesce((p_payload->>'long_term')::boolean, true),
    nullif(p_payload->>'other_amenities', ''),
    coalesce(p_payload->'detail_json', '{}'::jsonb),
    now()
  )
  on conflict (room_id)
  do update set
    electric_fee_value = case
      when p_payload ? 'electric_fee_value'
        then nullif(p_payload->>'electric_fee_value', '')::numeric
      else room_details.electric_fee_value
    end,
    electric_fee_unit = case
      when p_payload ? 'electric_fee_unit'
        then nullif(p_payload->>'electric_fee_unit', '')
      else room_details.electric_fee_unit
    end,
    water_fee_value = case
      when p_payload ? 'water_fee_value'
        then nullif(p_payload->>'water_fee_value', '')::numeric
      else room_details.water_fee_value
    end,
    water_fee_unit = case
      when p_payload ? 'water_fee_unit'
        then nullif(p_payload->>'water_fee_unit', '')
      else room_details.water_fee_unit
    end,
    service_fee_value = case
      when p_payload ? 'service_fee_value'
        then nullif(p_payload->>'service_fee_value', '')::numeric
      else room_details.service_fee_value
    end,
    service_fee_unit = case
      when p_payload ? 'service_fee_unit'
        then nullif(p_payload->>'service_fee_unit', '')
      else room_details.service_fee_unit
    end,
    parking_fee_value = case
      when p_payload ? 'parking_fee_value'
        then nullif(p_payload->>'parking_fee_value', '')::numeric
      else room_details.parking_fee_value
    end,
    parking_fee_unit = case
      when p_payload ? 'parking_fee_unit'
        then nullif(p_payload->>'parking_fee_unit', '')
      else room_details.parking_fee_unit
    end,
    other_fee_value = case
      when p_payload ? 'other_fee_value'
        then nullif(p_payload->>'other_fee_value', '')::numeric
      else room_details.other_fee_value
    end,
    other_fee_note = case
      when p_payload ? 'other_fee_note'
        then nullif(p_payload->>'other_fee_note', '')
      else room_details.other_fee_note
    end,
    has_elevator = case
      when p_payload ? 'has_elevator'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'has_elevator')::boolean, false)
      else room_details.has_elevator
    end,
    has_stairs = case
      when p_payload ? 'has_stairs'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'has_stairs')::boolean, false)
      else room_details.has_stairs
    end,
    shared_washer = case
      when p_payload ? 'shared_washer'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'shared_washer')::boolean, false)
      else room_details.shared_washer
    end,
    private_washer = case
      when p_payload ? 'private_washer'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'private_washer')::boolean, false)
      else room_details.private_washer
    end,
    shared_dryer = case
      when p_payload ? 'shared_dryer'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'shared_dryer')::boolean, false)
      else room_details.shared_dryer
    end,
    private_dryer = case
      when p_payload ? 'private_dryer'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'private_dryer')::boolean, false)
      else room_details.private_dryer
    end,
    has_parking = case
      when p_payload ? 'has_parking'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'has_parking')::boolean, false)
      else room_details.has_parking
    end,
    has_basement = case
      when p_payload ? 'has_basement'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'has_basement')::boolean, false)
      else room_details.has_basement
    end,
    fingerprint_lock = case
      when p_payload ? 'fingerprint_lock'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'fingerprint_lock')::boolean, false)
      else room_details.fingerprint_lock
    end,
    allow_pet = v_allow_pet,
    allow_cat = v_allow_cat,
    allow_dog = v_allow_dog,
    no_pet = v_no_pet,
    short_term = case
      when p_payload ? 'short_term'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'short_term')::boolean, false)
      else room_details.short_term
    end,
    long_term = case
      when p_payload ? 'long_term'
        then coalesce((p_payload->>'long_term')::boolean, true)
      else room_details.long_term
    end,
    other_amenities = case
      when p_payload ? 'other_amenities'
        then nullif(p_payload->>'other_amenities', '')
      else room_details.other_amenities
    end,
    detail_json = case
      when p_payload ? 'detail_json'
        then coalesce(p_payload->'detail_json', '{}'::jsonb)
      else room_details.detail_json
    end;
end;
$function$

views.name: room_full_admin_l1
views.definition:
SELECT r.id,
    r.room_type,
    r.room_code,
    r.address,
    r.house_number,
    r.ward,
    r.district,
    r.price,
    r.status,
    r.description,
    r.chinh_sach,
    r.link_zalo,
    r.zalo_phone,
    r.owner_id,
    r.created_at,
    r.updated_at,
    r.is_hidden,
    r.lat,
    r.lng,
    COALESCE(rd.has_elevator, false) AS has_elevator,
    COALESCE(rd.has_stairs, false) AS has_stairs,
    COALESCE(rd.shared_washer, false) AS shared_washer,
    COALESCE(rd.private_washer, false) AS private_washer,
    COALESCE(rd.shared_dryer, false) AS shared_dryer,
    COALESCE(rd.private_dryer, false) AS private_dryer,
    COALESCE(rd.has_parking, false) AS has_parking,
    COALESCE(rd.has_basement, false) AS has_basement,
    COALESCE(rd.fingerprint_lock, false) AS fingerprint_lock,
    COALESCE(rd.allow_pet, false) AS allow_pet,
    COALESCE(rd.allow_cat, false) AS allow_cat,
    COALESCE(rd.allow_dog, false) AS allow_dog,
    COALESCE(rd.no_pet, false) AS no_pet,
    COALESCE(rd.short_term, false) AS short_term,
    COALESCE(rd.long_term, true) AS long_term,
    rd.other_amenities,
    rd.detail_json,
    rma.media
   FROM ((rooms r
     LEFT JOIN room_details rd ON ((rd.room_id = r.id)))
     LEFT JOIN room_media_agg rma ON ((rma.room_id = r.id)));

views.name: room_full_public
views.definition:
SELECT r.id,
    r.property_id,
    p.code AS property_code,
    p.name AS property_name,
    r.room_type,
    r.room_code,
    r.address,
    r.house_number,
    r.ward,
    r.district,
    r.price,
    r.status,
    r.description,
    r.created_at,
    r.updated_at,
    r.gallery_urls,
    COALESCE(rd.has_elevator, false) AS has_elevator,
    COALESCE(rd.has_stairs, false) AS has_stairs,
    COALESCE(rd.allow_pet, false) AS allow_pet,
    COALESCE(rd.allow_cat, false) AS allow_cat,
    COALESCE(rd.allow_dog, false) AS allow_dog,
    COALESCE(rd.no_pet, false) AS no_pet,
    COALESCE(rd.short_term, false) AS short_term,
    COALESCE(rd.long_term, true) AS long_term
   FROM ((rooms r
     JOIN properties p ON ((p.id = r.property_id)))
     LEFT JOIN room_details rd ON ((rd.room_id = r.id)))
  WHERE ((r.lifecycle_status = 'active'::text) AND (r.publish_status = 'published'::text) AND (COALESCE(r.is_hidden, false) = false) AND (p.approval_status = 'approved'::text) AND (p.lifecycle_status = 'active'::text));

views.name: room_media_agg
views.definition:
SELECT room_id,
    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'type', type, 'url', url, 'path', path, 'provider', provider, 'is_cover', COALESCE(is_cover, false), 'sort_order', COALESCE(sort_order, 0), 'created_at', created_at) ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN ((type = 'image'::text) AND (COALESCE(is_cover, false) = true)) THEN 0
            WHEN (type = 'image'::text) THEN 1
            WHEN (type = 'video'::text) THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END, COALESCE(sort_order, 999999), created_at, id) AS media
   FROM room_media
  GROUP BY room_id;
